hypotheses.claim: Separating cognition snapshot lifetime from the effect commit transaction and revalidating in a fresh commit transaction reduces stale-effect and lock-upgrade failure risk versus attempting to upgrade a long-lived cognition read snapshot.
hypotheses.falsifier: Matched Ubuntu H1 workloads show no stale-snapshot/lock benefit or show materially worse correctness/latency/recovery than a simpler transaction design.

hypotheses.claim: Effect-relevant dependency-closure revalidation can reduce false aborts versus whole-global-epoch invalidation while preserving rejection when state used by the effect has changed.
hypotheses.falsifier: Real H1 traces show relevant dependency discovery is incomplete, closure maintenance costs dominate, or whole-epoch invalidation has equivalent user-visible cost.

hypotheses.claim: FRANK recurrence experiments should separate loop trajectory formation from halt/readout selection, using fixed/external budget trajectories and post-hoc readouts as a mandatory baseline before selecting an end-to-end learned halt controller.
hypotheses.falsifier: Matched H1 experiments show an end-to-end learned halt gate improves verified outcome per compute without trajectory distortion or shallow-halt failure relative to decoupled baselines.

hypotheses.claim: A bounded ActiveAssembly with provenance/conflict preservation and re-expansion references can deliver better local-4B future-task utility per context/KV cost than naive summaries, full-context forcing, or retrieval-only baselines.
hypotheses.falsifier: Matched long-horizon H1/4B traces show catastrophic omission, higher correction recurrence, or no cost-adjusted utility advantage versus simpler context strategies.

hypotheses.claim: Needle should be evaluated as a staged proposal boundary: no-tool/necessity gate -> tool-positive candidate retrieval -> generative tool/arg proposal -> structural validation -> deterministic capability/effect gateway. The current contrastive head must not be treated as the no-tool oracle.
hypotheses.falsifier: A retrained unified selector with an explicit no-tool representation beats the staged design on calibrated no-tool/tool accuracy, latency, adversarial robustness and abstention without weakening authority boundaries.

hypotheses.claim: Timing-sensitive causal tests need observation configuration in execution identity when probe overhead is non-negligible relative to decision/re-entry slack.
hypotheses.falsifier: Matched Ubuntu H1 low/no/full instrumentation arms show paired semantic trajectories and causal readouts remain within preregistered equivalence tolerances.

hypotheses.claim: Slow semantic/topology promotion should distinguish independent ancestry from repeated source/re-entry echo, but provenance-diversity gating must be compared against simpler robust source weighting because it can slow genuine reversal.
hypotheses.falsifier: Simpler source weighting matches echo resistance with lower reversal lag, or provenance-family identity is too noisy/spoofable to improve real H1 outcomes.

hypotheses.claim: H3 can collapse H1 diagnostic modules into one binary without collapsing authority semantics if a logical cognitive proposal barrier and a deterministic runtime capability/commit barrier remain non-bypassable and differential-tested.
hypotheses.falsifier: One-binary consolidation introduces bypass, fault-containment, recovery or tail-latency regressions that are prevented by a physically isolated boundary.

counterhypotheses: A conventional persistent event-driven architecture with bounded retrieval and a deterministic effect gateway is sufficient; FRANK-specific GWT/loop machinery adds no net value.
Whole-epoch invalidation is operationally simpler and cheap enough that dependency-closure revalidation complexity is not justified.
End-to-end learned halting outperforms trajectory/readout decoupling once trained on real FRANK data.
Raw retrieval/reranking with larger context beats ActiveAssembly because assembly compression omits future-critical information.
A retrained unified Needle no-tool/tool selector is better than staged routing.
Observer effect is negligible on the target Ubuntu runtime and requires only a one-time NO_CHANGE calibration receipt.
Provenance-family metadata is too noisy or gameable; context-aware scalar weighting is sufficient.
A one-binary authority barrier is too weak against implementation bugs and effect execution must remain physically isolated.
